name: QuSpin QZFM Gen.2 / Neuro-1

specs.form_factor: sensor head ~2 cm, worn against scalp

cost.note: Individual sensor units likely $8-12k retail; full MEG array $250k+

deployment: 50-sensor QuSpin OPM-MEG array operational (announced 2024). Widely used in research.
bci_relevance: LEADING platform for independent-researcher-accessible quantum BCI sensing. Single QZFM Gen.2 sensor at ~$7.7k is within $20k budget including electronics. fT-class sensitivity achievable in mu-metal shielding.
